plugins.name: MaxoGranular
plugins.description: A granular synth in a worn analog rack: two grain generators, filter, envelopes, drawn LFOs, patch-cable modulation, delay and reverb.
plugins.long: MaxoGranular cuts sounds into tiny grains and plays them as clouds, pads, textures or playable tones. Two grain generators (24 built-in sounds or your own WAV files) in Cloud or pitch-locked Sync mode, a filter, three envelopes, four drawn LFOs and macros you patch onto any knob with a cable, tape delay and reverb. Behind a worn hammertone rack with phosphor CRT screens where every grain glows, tape reels that turn with the scan and VU meters.
features: Two grain layers: Cloud (random grains) or Sync (locked to the note), up to 8 streams each
Your own sound: LOAD, or drag WAV / AIFF / FLAC / MP3 / OGG / M4A onto the window; 24 built-in sounds
Position, Scan, Spray, Size 1 ms - 2 s, Density, Jitter, Pitch, Skew, Reverse, Stereo, Detune
Filter with 7 types and a draggable response curve
3 envelopes and 4 drawn LFOs (free / retrig / 1-shot, tempo sync)
Patch cables: drag from a jack onto any knob, coloured rings, matrix with 32 routes
Tape delay and 14 reverb types, Poly / Mono / Legato with glide
57 factory presets in 9 categories, favourites and your own presets

plugins.name: NyashkChannel
plugins.description: SSL-style channel strip: input stage, filters, expander / gate, compressor and a 4-band EQ in one plugin.
plugins.long: A complete console channel in one plugin, in the spirit of the SSL E / G channel: input section with line and mic gain, high-pass and low-pass filters, expander / gate, compressor with auto makeup, a four-band EQ (BROWN and BLACK voicing), and an output fader with width and mono. Modern analog faceplate in the console style: colour-capped knobs with LED rings per section, lit push buttons and LED meters.
features: Live output spectrum behind the EQ curve, HP / LP filters drawn on the graph
DYN view: expander / gate and compressor curve with the live level
Input: polarity, -20 dB pad, line trim, mic gain, ANALOG saturation
HP 18 dB/oct and LP filters, optionally on the dynamics sidechain only (SPLIT)
Expander / gate with threshold, range, release and fast attack
Compressor with soft knee, ratio up to infinity, release, fast attack and auto makeup
Dynamics before or after the EQ
4-band EQ: LF and HF shelf or bell, LMF and HMF with Q, BROWN / BLACK character
Output fader, stereo width and mono, in / out and gain reduction meters

plugins.name: NyashkEQ
plugins.description: 24-band dynamic EQ with spectral dynamics, Zero Latency / Natural Phase / Linear Phase processing, per-band mid / side and side chain.
plugins.long: A full-featured equalizer: up to 24 bands with ten shapes and slopes up to 96 dB/oct or brickwall, every band dynamic or spectral, placed on stereo, left, right, mid or side. Zero Latency, Natural Phase and Linear Phase processing, a configurable analyzer with spectrum grab, collision view and EQ match, EQ sketch and a piano display.
features: 24 bands, 10 shapes: bell, shelves, cuts, notch, band pass, tilt, flat tilt, all pass; 6–96 dB/oct and brickwall
Dynamic EQ on every band: range ±30 dB, auto or manual threshold, attack / release, free trigger range, external side chain, band solo
Spectral dynamics: only the frequencies that stick out are compressed or expanded, with density and tilt
Zero Latency, Natural Phase and Linear Phase (5 resolutions)
Per-band Stereo / Left / Right / Mid / Side
Analyzer: pre / post / side chain, range, resolution, speed, tilt, freeze, spectrum grab, collisions, EQ match
EQ Sketch, piano display, A/B, undo / redo
Character (Clean / Subtle / Warm), auto gain, gain scale, output gain / pan / phase

plugins.name: NyashkAir
plugins.description: Adds smooth air and presence to vocals and mixes without harshness.
plugins.long: An air and presence exciter in the spirit of Slate Fresh Air. Two knobs add brightness and openness in the mids and highs, with dynamic reduction so it does not get harsh, and a live curve that shows exactly what is being added. Modern analog faceplate in light anodised aluminium with machined knobs, blue LED rings and a glass curve display.
features: Live spectrum of input and output behind the air curve
MID AIR and HIGH AIR knobs, LINK to move them together
Dynamic reduction keeps the top smooth
Live curve of the added energy
Input / output meters and trim, click-free power

plugins.name: NyashkPre
plugins.description: Light vocal preamp and saturator with tube, iron and clean character plus a simple tone section.
plugins.long: A light vocal preamp: gain and drive into three characters (tube, iron transformer, clean solid-state) followed by low cut, warmth, presence and silk. Auto level keeps loudness steady while you set the sound. Modern analog faceplate: a red gain knob on a metal skirt, machined knobs with LED rings, lit buttons and glass screens.
features: Live spectrum behind the tone curve and a live trace on the saturation curve
Gain and Drive with saturation curve display
TUBE, IRON and CLEAN character
Low cut, Warmth, Presence and Silk tone controls
Parallel MIX, AUTO LEVEL, polarity, output

plugins.name: NyashkMeter
plugins.description: Master-bus analyser: LUFS (momentary, short-term, integrated), LRA, true peak, spectrum, stereo and tonal balance.
plugins.long: A mastering meter that passes audio through untouched. ITU-R BS.1770-4 loudness with momentary, short-term and gated integrated LUFS, loudness range, true peak, a spectrum with selectable source, goniometer, correlation, loudness history and tonal balance.
features: Momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, LRA, max values
Targets: -9, -14, -16, -23 LUFS with history line
True peak (4x), sample peak, PLR and overs count
Spectrum: curve or 1/3 octave, L+R / MID / SIDE / L / R, slopes, speed, hold
Goniometer, correlation and balance
Tonal balance across six bands
Loudness history 1 or 5 minutes

plugins.name: NyashkKey
plugins.description: Finds the key of a sample, beat or track and how far its tuning is off 440 Hz (sped-up samples), with the values to type into NyashkTune.
features: Key (major / minor, all 12 keys) with confidence, relative key and Camelot code
Two next best keys with how close they are
Tuning offset in cents and the matching Ref A4 (e.g. +39 c = 449.9 Hz)
Notes view: whole analysis and right now, scale notes and tonic marked
Key, Scale and Ref A4 ready for NyashkTune
HOLD, RESET, note spelling AUTO / sharps / flats; audio passes through untouched
plugins.long: Put it on a sample, a beat or the master bus and play. NyashkKey collects every note it hears in a one-cent pitch histogram, works out how far the tuning is off the 440 Hz grid (a sample that was sped up or slowed down) and matches the tuned notes against major and minor key profiles. It shows the key, how sure it is, the relative key, the Camelot code, the tuning and Ref A4, and the Key / Scale / Ref A4 to use in NyashkTune.

plugins.name: DauBiko
plugins.description: All-in-one master bus: tone EQ, one DYNAMICS knob from glue to punch, tape / tube color, width and a lookahead limiter.
plugins.long: An analog-style mastering processor with a worn vintage console face: brushed and scratched metal, machined aluminium knobs, chrome toggles, backlit VU meters and an amber screen with the live spectrum. Shape the tone, set the dynamics with one big knob (left glues the mix together, right makes it punch), add tape or tube color, adjust the stereo image and finish with a lookahead limiter.
features: Tone: low cut, LOW 80 Hz, BODY 250 Hz, PRESENCE 3.2 kHz, AIR 12 kHz and TILT, with a live curve
DYNAMICS knob: GLUE (bus compression with auto makeup) to PUNCH (transient lift, tighter tails), 1 ms lookahead
COLOR: TAPE or TUBE saturation, 2x oversampled
STEREO: width 0 to 200 % and BASS MONO below 120 Hz
OUTPUT: gain into a 1.5 ms lookahead limiter with ceiling
VU meters, live spectrum, gain change and limiter LEDs, click-free bypass, resizable window

plugins.name: NyashkOpto
plugins.description: LA-2A style optical compressor with program-dependent attack, two-stage release, compress / limit modes and analog hum + saturation.
plugins.long: A model of an optical (opto-cell) compressor in the spirit of the LA-2A. Attack is program-dependent and release is two-stage with memory, so it breathes like the hardware. Simple to use: Peak Reduction and Gain do most of the work. Modern analog faceplate: machined aluminium knobs with LED rings, a backlit VU with a needle under a curved cover, and lit push buttons.
features: Live waveform (input / output) with the gain reduction line
Peak Reduction: amount of compression; Gain: output level
COMPRESS or LIMIT mode
Hi Freq (HF Follow): emphasis in the sidechain to tame sibilance
ANALOG: OFF / 50 Hz / 60 Hz soft saturation with mains hum, like real hardware
Mix for parallel compression, Auto Makeup and Trim
VU meter with INPUT, GR and OUTPUT views
Transparent at Peak Reduction 0, click-free bypass

plugins.name: NyashkTune
plugins.description: Real-time pitch correction with the controls of a classic real-time tuner, from transparent tuning that keeps the singer's vibrato to the hard quantized effect.
plugins.long: Real-time vocal pitch correction laid out like a classic hardware-simple tuner: Speed and Note Transition, Tolerance, Vibrato with depth, Correction amount and Formant corrected / non-corrected. The note is chosen on the note centre with the vibrato taken out, so a wide vibrato never flips it, and the tuner never pulls the voice further than its own target.
features: Speed (0.1-800 ms) and Note Transition with Link
Tolerance in cents and time: the note changes only past 50 + tol cents for tol ms
Vibrato On keeps the singer's vibrato (Depth 0-200 %), Off gives the hard quantized effect
Correction amount 1-100 %, Formant corrected / non-corrected
Keyboard note states: Legal, Illegal, pitch up / down, Bypass; drag the correction range
16 scales plus Custom, root with sharps or flats, Reference A4 415-466 Hz
Voice ranges from Bass to Soprano, MIDI target, correction meter and IN / OUT meters
McLeod pitch detection and pitch-synchronous resampling (whole periods repeated or skipped): no sub-octave thumps, the voice unchanged at zero correction

plugins.name: NyashkFormant
plugins.description: Move the formants of a voice without touching its pitch, or transpose it while keeping its own timbre. The formant section of NyashkTune 1.x as its own plugin.
plugins.long: A real-time vocal formant and pitch shifter. Shift the formants for a smaller, brighter or a bigger, darker vocal tract, tilt them, transpose the pitch with the voice's own formants kept or let them follow. Five algorithms from classic PSOLA resampling to a sharp true-envelope filter and an all-pole vocal model, with a live view of the voice's formants before and after.
features: Formant Shift ±12 st, Tilt and Follow; Keep Formants for transposing
Transpose ±12 st and Detune ±100 c
5 algorithms: Classic, Smooth, Detailed (true envelope), Vocal (LPC), Bend
Auto Gain keeps the level when shifting or transposing
Air and Drive colour, Mix and Output
Live formant view: input and output envelopes with F1 / F2 marked
Bit-exact pass-through at neutral settings, click-free at any setting
Voice ranges from Bass to Soprano
Low latency: about 11 ms for formant shifts, 0 ms when only colour is used

plugins.name: NyashkLimit
plugins.description: Make a master loud and clean: a two-stage look-ahead limiter with true peak control, loudness meters and dither in one plugin.
plugins.long: A mastering limiter for the final stage of a mix. Two limiting stages (a slow one for the body, a fast look-ahead one for transients) shaped by eight styles, true peak limiting with up to 32x oversampling, and a scrolling display that shows input, output, gain reduction and loudness. Loudness metering follows BS.1770 / EBU R128, and dither with noise shaping finishes the file for delivery.
features: 8 limiting styles, from transparent to aggressive
Look-ahead, attack, release and channel link for transients and release
True peak limiting (dBTP) with oversampling up to 32x
Output ceiling with delivery presets, Unity Gain and Audition
Dither 16-24 bit with three noise-shaping curves, DC filter, side chain
Scrolling display with gain-reduction peak labels, four display modes
Level, K-System and loudness meters: M / S / I, LRA, targets
Compact view with big numbers, presets, A/B, undo / redo

plugins.name: WaveCube
plugins.tagline: Modular shaper: build a chain, draw the shapes
plugins.description: A chain of up to 12 items (the same kind as often as you like): volume, filter, pan, width, time, noise, crush, drive, reverb, liquid, compressor and scope, each following its own drawn shapes in time with your song.
plugins.long: Build your own chain of up to 12 items in any order, with duplicates (two Drives, three Volumes...): Volume, Filter (cutoff and resonance, clean or warm), Pan with Haas, Width, Time (tape stops, beat repeats, 16 s back), Noise (24 noises + your WAVs), Crush (bits and resample), Drive (12 styles), Reverb (14 spaces + your impulse responses, send and return shapes), Liquid (flanger / phaser), plus Compressor and Scope tools anywhere in the chain. Every lane has its own drawn shape, LFO (song sync, Hz or MIDI pitch; MIDI / audio trigger; 1-shot) and envelope follower with sidechain, per band in multiband mode. 136 factory presets, item presets, A/B, undo of everything, click-free changes, tested at every sample rate.
features: Chain of up to 12 items, any order, duplicates; right-click: duplicate, replace, copy / paste, reset
Volume, Filter, Pan, Width, Time, Noise, Crush, Drive, Reverb, Liquid + Compressor and Scope tools
Two shapes (lanes) where it makes sense: cutoff / resonance, bits / resample, send / volume…; drag a lane to offset it
LFO per lane and band: Beat, Hz up to 5 kHz or MIDI pitch; Sync, MIDI or audio trigger; 1-shot with an end marker; swing, stereo offset
Envelope follower per lane and band: band, filtered input or sidechain; depth, shift, adaptive, listen
Multiband per item: 3 bands, own shapes, LFOs, envelopes, mix and solo; 6 / 12 / 24 dB splits
Shape editor: points, curves, select tool, pens, shape categories, random, x2 / x3, copy / paste, 9 custom waves with MIDI Switch
24 noises and 14 reverb spaces plus your own WAV noises and impulse responses
136 factory presets, 64 item presets, browser with filters by item, random preset, A/B, undo / redo
Click-free changes, same sound at 22-192 kHz, no latency, safety clipper
